list.title: Stock transfers
list.description: Transfer requests between sibling dealers or distributors under the same parent.
list.forbidden: You do not have permission to view stock transfers.
list.empty_description: Transfer requests you send, receive or approve appear here.
kind.label: Type
form.title: New stock transfer
form.description: Hand units from your stock over to a sibling organization under the same parent.
form.error: The transfer request could not be sent.
form.no_targets: There is no sibling organization under your parent to transfer to.
form.target_hint: Only organizations under the same parent are listed.
form.barcode_hint: Pieces and rolls move whole; enter a quantity only for fixed barcodes.

return.description: Return units from your stock to your parent organization (distributor or center).
return.target_hint: A return goes only to your direct parent organization, which approves and receives it.
return.no_parent: Your organization has no parent organization to return stock to.
detail.title: Transfer request
detail.error: The action could not be completed.
detail.reason_hint: The reason is kept with the transfer request.

errors.TRANSFER_NOT_PARENT: Stock can be returned only to your direct parent organization.
errors.TRANSFER_INVALID_TRANSITION: The transfer status does not allow this action.
errors.TRANSFER_STOCK_UNAVAILABLE: The stock movement was refused: a unit is no longer in the sender's stock.
errors.TRANSFER_UNIT_NOT_FOUND: No unit with this barcode was found.
errors.TRANSFER_UNIT_NOT_AVAILABLE: This unit is not in your organization's stock.
